column1: # ci/PROD_INVARIANTS.tsv -- the content a rebase must not quietly take away.
# Each row is one statement that was TRUE of the tree we built and shipped, and that a
# correct merge with upstream preserves.  They exist because of W1176: `git rebase --onto`
# resolved two conflicts with `checkout --theirs`, so engine/src/program/generate.cpp and
# engine/src/prefill/prefill.cpp became the OLD branch copies -- 1,973 lines of our own
# work (the CPU-share worker pool, the MMQ tier sort, the P2P peer_i8 staging) vanished
# while every static check stayed green.  A grep cannot be "resolved" away.
#   contains   <literal>   the file must contain this literal
#   min_lines  <n>         the file must still have at least n lines (a floor, not a pin)
# Add a row whenever a rebase is found to have dropped something: the row is the regression
# test for that loss.  Keep values stable across upstream bumps; use floors, not exact counts.
